source_name: PubMed Central JATS formulas — adaptation-safe Creative Commons lane

bulk_access.note: The 2026 PMC Article Dataset distribution uses the AWS Cloud Service. Legacy article-dataset FTP/OA Web Service paths are not acquisition backends for this adapter.

license_policy.lane: adaptation-safe Creative Commons subset for derived Parquet publication
license_policy.enforcement: Acquisition should prefilter from PMC metadata/inventory and the adapter independently fails closed unless the JATS license URI is recognized as CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA. PMC documents CC BY-ND among commercial-reuse filters, but the Atlas excludes no-derivatives licenses from this derived-data lane until stage-specific treatment of adaptations is audited.

scope.record_granularity: one occurrence per non-empty JATS formula element

adapter.input: local tree of JATS XML acquired from the license-filtered PMC AWS Article Dataset

snapshot_policy.rule: Pin the PMC daily inventory object used for selection and record its retrieval date, ETag when available, and SHA-256. Hash the selected article-version inventory rows/metadata deterministically; that digest is part of the Atlas snapshot identity.
snapshot_policy.reason: PMC is continuously updated and does not create a new article-version prefix for every metadata/content change, so a calendar date alone is not a sufficient immutable snapshot.
snapshot_policy.immutability: A distinct inventory/selection digest is a distinct Atlas snapshot and Internet Archive item.
